title: observability-automation-private-installs-prometheus-grafana-helm-terraform
author: Priya Kaur
description: Automates observability stack provisioning for Private installs (VPC/on-prem) by adding Helm and Terraform automation for Prometheus, Grafana, log shipping (fluentd -> Loki/Cloud), dashboard provisioning, and alert rules. Motivation: reduce manual post-install steps for customers and enable reproducible observability across Private and Dedicated deployments. This PR bundles three pieces: 1) Helm chart additions and opinionated values for Prometheus/Grafana (chart templates, CRDs, and values schema); 2) Terraform modules to provision observability components as part of the installer flow (VPC networking outputs, k8s namespace, values secrets integration); 3) Installer pipeline hooks to run chart releases and apply dashboards/alerts via Grafana provisioning. Changes include defaults tuned for Private deployments (resource requests/limits, nodeAffinity tolerations for on-prem nodes), optional TLS and KMS-backed secrets for dashboards, and a lightweight log-forwarder profile for air-gapped installs. Checklist: - [x] Helm chart + values schema - [x] Terraform module + examples - [x] Installer hooks + idempotent apply/rollback support - [x] Grafana provisioning YAML and example dashboards - [x] Prometheus alert rules and onboarding docs - [x] CI pipeline tests (helm lint, terraform fmt/validate, k8s dry-run) Usage notes: the installer will now expose an --with-observability flag. For existing Private installs the upgrade path will run a dry-run then create k8s objects; a rollback target is included. See rollout_notes for safe upgrade steps.

review_comments: Daniel Park: Overall looks good. Two things: make the Grafana provisioning optional and ensure dashboards are not overwritten on upgrade by default.
Priya Kaur (author): Good call — added a grafana.overwriteDashboards flag (default: false) and a note in docs.
Sofia Martinez: CI flake on helm lint for prometheus chart. Found missing annotations in CRD. Please address.
Priya Kaur: Fixed CRD annotations and added helm lint job to run on PR. Re-ran CI — lint/validate pass.
Ethan Zhou (approval): Verified terraform module has proper outputs for installer; tested with the example in our sandbox cluster. Approving pending release note entry.
release_notes: Add optional observability automation for Private installs: Prometheus + Grafana + log-forwarder via Helm and Terraform
New installer flag --with-observability to bootstrap monitoring during install/upgrade
Grafana provisioning supports optional dashboard overwrite (default: disabled)
Terraform module redwood_observability for customers to integrate observability into infra-as-code
Non-breaking default; disabled unless --with-observability is set
rollout_notes: Safe upgrade: run installer with --with-observability --dry-run to validate manifests first
If running on air-gapped clusters, pre-pull chart images and provide local chart repo via --chart-repo
Rollback: installer provides --rollback-observability which removes created helm releases and k8s objects created by this flow
Alerting: initial rules are conservative; customers should review silence windows before enabling critical alerts
